Exact, but harder to read: lines over 240 chars 45 -> 55, max 572 -> 611.
regressions.rule: Keep a named variable for a value used several times when its expression is longer than a few terms (memory reads, base + size sums), even when the analysis proves it could be inlined; inline only single-use or short values.

improvements: Raw-argument calls 78 -> 48 (named calls 3 -> 28: tokens(), balanceOf(this), transferFrom with args, the LibSilo delegatecall with '_176, _param1'). 52 array bounds checks (Panic(50)) and 2 allocation checks (Panic(65)) that an identical dominating check implies are dropped; the writes between them are only to the hash scratch (mem[0], mem[32]) or above the free pointer. Events have exact fields (TransferSingle id = _param1 << 96 | uint96(_param2), InternalBalanceChanged delta, and the values of the two unnamed logs). 32 Error(string) and the custom-error reverts are decoded, and P6 (76) is gone. Text 542 lines shorter.
notes: The two functions unknown081d77ba and unknownc56411f6 changed order in the text, so the shipped diff matches the wrong pair (hunk -2941,1009 +3665,6). I reviewed all 7 functions with per-function diffs of the old and new texts (250-960 lines each), read by structure: per function the calls, events, whiles (151) and requires are unchanged. Removed Panic(50) checks were checked in their loops (getTokenEntitlementsAndBalances: 'if s >= mem[_730]' kept at the loop head, later copies dropped across scratch writes; the 'mem[_771]' copies dropped after the first; checks after a write to another array, e.g. 's >= mem[_730]' after 'mem[_771 + 32 * s + 32] = ...', are kept). Moved reads were checked, e.g. 'int96(mem[_179 + 32])' for the old _223: nothing writes _179 + 32 between line 202 and its use. stagecheck --function 0xf242432a: 320 calls, all same, but all revert early in empty and random worlds, so they do not reach these loops. The 14 rotated getNonBeanIndex loops (P3 by reading) are unchanged; the regex no longer counts them. The transferFrom selector still prints in decimal (len 4] = 599290589).
summary: One low regression: length snapshots and allocation bases are now inlined as long expressions. Otherwise better: 52 dominated bounds checks dropped, 25 more calls decoded, events and 32 string/custom-error reverts decoded, P6 gone. Nested-mapping obscurity remains, and 35 raw reverts remain where mem[64] is unresolved.
